script:
import json,os,subprocess,time,datetime
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspaces/llm-project')
clone=Path('/workspaces/llm-project-cleancheck-'+datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'))
out=root/'artifacts/clean-docker-validation.json'
r={'state':'running','scope':'Fresh GitHub clone, existing Docker daemon and model volume, tracked LLM cache; not a fresh uncached benchmark','clone':str(clone),'checks':[]}
env=dict(os.environ,COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME='llm-project')
def save():out.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+chr(10))
def run(cmd,cwd,stdin=None):
 t=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=cwd,env=env,input=stdin,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=900)
 r['checks'].append({'command':cmd,'cwd':str(cwd),'exit_code':p.returncode,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-t,2),'output':p.stdout+p.stderr});save();print(cmd,p.returncode,(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-700:],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(cmd))
 return p.stdout
try:
 run(['git','clone','--quiet','https://github.com/PohjoinenJohtaja/llm-project.git',str(clone)],root)
 r['commit']=run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],clone).strip()
 assert not run(['git','status','--porcelain'],clone).strip()
 names=['graph.json','communities.json','eval_baseline.json','eval_local.json','eval_global.json','eval_agent.json','eval_extraction.json','index_stats.json']
 before={n:json.loads((clone/'artifacts'/n).read_text()) for n in names}
 run(['cp','.env.example','.env'],clone)
 p=clone/'.env';text=p.read_text().replace('LLM_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1','LLM_BASE_URL=http://llm:11434/v1').replace('EMBED_MODEL=bge-m3','EMBED_MODEL=bge-m3-cpu');p.write_text(text)
 run(['make','down'],root)
 run(['make','up-llm'],clone)
 run(['docker','compose','exec','-T','llm','ollama','list'],clone)
 run(['docker','compose','exec','-T','llm','sh','-c','cat > /tmp/Modelfile.bge-m3-cpu'],clone,(clone/'artifacts/Modelfile.bge-m3-cpu').read_text())
 run(['docker','compose','exec','-T','llm','ollama','create','bge-m3-cpu','-f','/tmp/Modelfile.bge-m3-cpu'],clone)
 for cmd in [['make','up'],['make','index'],['make','test'],['make','test','ARGS=tests erp/tests src/assistant'],['make','lint'],['make','eval-all'],['make','eval-extraction']]:run(cmd,clone)
 r['matches']={}
 for n in names:
  a=before[n];b=json.loads((clone/'artifacts'/n).read_text())
  if n=='index_stats.json':
   r['replayed_index_stats']=b
   a=json.loads(json.dumps(a));b=json.loads(json.dumps(b));a['llm'].pop('cache_hits',None);b['llm'].pop('cache_hits',None)
  r['matches'][n]=a==b
 assert all(r['matches'].values())
 r['state']='completed'
except Exception as e:r['state']='failed';r['error']=repr(e)
finally:
 save()
 print('CLEAN_DOCKER',r['state'],flush=True)
